idle.note: the hero's cut-out bob: torso, head and both free arms drop 2 px and return as one rigid group; pelvis, legs and feet still

move.note: a light, quick walk on the protagonist's model: both legs step, six steps per tile rest to rest, the near foot leading; 7 px lift (the long rear leg needs the higher swing to out-bend its stance knee); the pelvis settles 2 px after each landing; a 3 degree lean; each arm swings from the shoulder like a pendulum, opposite its same-side leg, and the forearm trails the upper arm

arm_swing._doc: Director (owner 2026-10-20: 'the arms don't sway realistically during the walk'). The upper arm rotates about the shoulder joint in screen space toward the facing direction (forward) and away from it (back), opposite the same-side leg; the forearm follows the upper arm with a time lag and bends more on the backswing; the hand is rigid with the forearm. Replaces the 4 px hand-target slide.

envelope._doc: Director rr-29 fb1: swing amplitude and forearm lag ramp in over the first and out over the last 12% of the clip, so the walk starts and ends exactly at rest.

bolt.note: the leading arm (hand_far: the arm on the target's side in both 3/4 views) draws back, then thrusts open-palmed at the target as the shadow bolt leaves (contact), reaching out of the black silhouette so the gesture reads at board scale; the body leans 4 degrees into it; the near hand pulls back

mirror.note: mirrors your last attack: it crouches with both hands drawn back, then thrusts both hands at the target (contact; the copied effect plays), the leading hand (hand_far) reaching furthest so the thrust leaves the black silhouette, mask tipped forward; recovers

block.note: crosses both forearms in front of the mask and sinks 2 px behind them; holds; lowers

hit.note: spec hit: torso knocked 3 px back and 1 px down with a 3 degree lean back, head nods back 4 degrees, both hands trail 1 px; recovered by 0.6

death.note: the knees give: the pelvis drops 20 px over planted boots, the torso pitches forward 22 degrees, the mask bows, the hands drop; terminal pose held, then the existing fade
